title: Mobile Bottom Navigation, PWA Custom Context Menu & Modal Scroll Lock
summary: Introduces a fixed mobile bottom navigation dock with animated settings, locks background scrolling during modal gestures, and adds native-like PWA user-select rules with custom desktop and mobile context menus.

changes.text: Fixed Mobile Bottom Navigation: added an always-visible floating glass dock on mobile with Home, Inventory, Database, and an animated Settings button with spinning gear feedback and squash-and-stretch thumb sliding.
Custom Context & Hold Menus for PWA: replaced native browser context menu on desktop PWA with a custom glass quick actions menu, and added touch-hold long press action sheets on mobile PWA.
Modal Background Scroll Lock: locked document body scrolling and touchover actions when modals are mounted, preventing background scroll when swiping material cards.
PWA Native App Feel: disabled user text selection and callouts in standalone PWA mode while keeping input and textarea selection enabled.
